about.description: Papa Rocco's is a casual pizza, oyster, and wings restaurant in Gulf Shores, Alabama, featuring daily live music entertainment until midnight. Known for award-winning pizzas and fresh local oysters, the restaurant offers a relaxed atmosphere with great service and affordable happy hour pricing.
about.elevator_pitch: Award-winning pizza and oyster restaurant in Gulf Shores with daily live music, happy hour specials, and a fun, casual atmosphere.
about.vibe: Relaxed, fun, casual bar and grill atmosphere with live entertainment daily
about.insider_tip: Best Happy Hour prices in town from 11am-7pm Monday-Friday with $3 domestic beers and $3.50 house liquor
